audience: operations teams that run store, site or field audits in GoAudits

useCases.title: Find low audit scores by location
useCases.text: List one summary row per audit in a date range, with score, status, location and auditor. Then list the locations.

useCases.title: Open one audit's answers
useCases.text: Read the question-by-question answers, scores and comments of one audit. The date range must include the audit date.

useCases.title: Review open corrective actions
useCases.text: List corrective action items for a date range with their owners and due dates, or read the items of one audit.

useCases.title: Look up checklists and users
useCases.text: List the audit checklists and the users with their roles, such as admins, managers and auditors.
